## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/compute.py` was run and the regenerated `derived.csv`, `derived.json` and `site/index.html` are committed
- [ ] Every new or changed number in `data/plans.json` has an `evidence` entry pointing at a source id in `data/sources.json`
- [ ] New sources are recorded in `data/sources.json` with title, url, licence, retrieval date, and what they cover
- [ ] If this is contributed measurement data, the licensing confirmation from the issue or PR description is included
- [ ] No annual, promotional or regional pricing was introduced
- [ ] No DeepSWE task content was mirrored
- [ ] CC BY 4.0 attribution for figures sourced from Awesome Coding Plan is intact, if touched
